headline: Approved January minutes, tabled OSRP chart review, and set meeting schedule exceptions 3-0.
summary: The Board of Health approved the January 21, 2026 meeting minutes, tabled review of the Open Space and Recreation Plan chart, and voted to skip meetings in June, July, August, and December unless a board member, the director, or three members of the public request one. The director reported on tobacco compliance fines, overdose data, TB and latent infection cases, food inspections, and language access services.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the January 21, 2026 meeting, 3-0.
Tabled review of the Open Space and Recreation Plan (OSRP) chart, 3-0.
Passed a motion that the Board refrain from meeting in June, July, August, and December, with three exceptions, 3-0.
